bindings: Original renderer, snapshot models and token estimator are compiled from pinned RPCE source.

The immutable root/entry adapter and native field parser are reused from the recorded smip adapter revision; these fixtures do not independently verify trie construction. Selected-root filtering and marker flags are passed explicitly to the original snapshot renderer.
Logical root labels are supplied as data. Empty selection uses the MCP provider message.
limits: Public MCP and admitted startup tests cover selection and available-codemap projection separately.
No desktop watcher, ignore-policy or codemap demand coordination is exercised by the synthetic snapshots.
